Privacy

This website uses no cookies, no tracking and no third-party advertising.

The contact form opens your own e-mail app. We only receive the information you choose to send us and use it solely to answer your enquiry.

Photos and text on this site come from the club's own Instagram and Facebook posts, or were produced for the club. If you want a photo removed, please contact grimstadbk@gmail.com.

The map on the contact page is loaded from Google Maps. When the map is shown, Google may collect information under its own privacy policy.
